_about: MAIN RUN. The realism set: the hand-written items of data/realism/, six pairs of sources each, each order the chat format allows, bare and inside their own context. It builds only once the batches are written and pass check_realism. Read it with scripts/layouts.sh main-realism-qwen3-4b-nothink.
qwen3-4b on v100-vllm085, thinking off (study-nothink). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-realism-qwen3-4b-nothink, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh qwen3-4b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
